meaning: reports/release.json production_status and release_ready only say the route passed Synth's router and DRC gates. They are not review sign-off.

routing_and_drc.evidence: DRC: 135 unconnected pads. 2 open nets (+12V_PROT, +3V3). Routing failed due to placement issues (connectors not flush, support parts too far from pads). Placement requires revision.

erc_dispositioned.evidence: 56 ERC warnings, 0 errors. See synth_validate output.

placement_review.evidence: Visual review requires revision: J1/J3/J4/J5 not flush with board edges, support parts too far from served pads, decoupling caps too far from regulators.
